description:
Job Requirements: 
 
• Understanding the Out of box Sharepoint2013 features 
 
• Ability to develop custom solutions using ASP.NET 
 
• Powershell is must - Windows Powershell for SharePoint is getting better day-by-day with more tools in the market for Scripting and debugging(PowerShell_ISE ,PrimalScript etc). Although the same activities can also be performed using C# Object model ,the advantage of using powershell is minimal coding. 
 
• Jquery and REST API - With Jquery ,you have fewer deployment issues, less “customization”, Improved visuals, Rapid deployment and modifications, reduced planeload timings, delayed data queries and many more advantages. 
 
• Client Side Object Model - CSOM capabilities have been enhanced in SharePoint 2013. This model will provide the ability to perform CRUD operations. One of the biggest advantages of using CSOM is the performance. 
 
• Extensive Custom Workflow creation and maintenance. 
 
• Documentation and training Skills 



 SharePoint, ASP.NET, Powershell, documentation and training
